title: Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Disinfect aprons, towels, handkerchiefs and socks by sunlight, salt water, boiling (by the teacher) and ironing. Chemical disinfectants are used diluted by an adult only, following the label.

skills.key_step: The child describes methods of disinfecting (sunlight, salt solution, boiling, diluted disinfectants, ironing) and matches them to articles: boiling for white cotton, sun for most, ironing for cottons, disinfectant by an adult.
steps: Choose a method that suits it.

misconceptions.ask: A towel looks clean. Is it free of germs?
misconceptions.repair: Recall hand washing: germs cannot be seen.

misconceptions.ask: Can a coloured nylon item be boiled to disinfect it?
misconceptions.repair: Show a coloured item faded and shrunk by boiling.

misconceptions.ask: How does drying in strong sun help hygiene?
misconceptions.repair: Explain the sun's ultraviolet rays kill many germs.
Talk about ironing school uniforms against lice and germs.

checks.question: Name two methods of disinfecting clothes.
checks.answer: any two of sunlight, salt, boiling, disinfectant, ironing

checks.question: Why is a coloured nylon article not boiled?

skills.key_step: The child says how to disinfect: wash first, choose the method for the fabric, boil white cottons 10 to 15 minutes or soak in salt water, dry in full sun, iron hot, disinfectant only diluted by an adult and rinsed, store dry.

board.do: Write the cards: dry in sun, wash, boil.

listen_for: Nothing, disinfect it as it is
misconceptions.ask: What is done before disinfecting a towel?
misconceptions.repair: Recall Grade 7: disinfectant works only on a clean surface.

misconceptions.ask: How is a chemical disinfectant used on clothes?
misconceptions.repair: Read a disinfectant label's dilution and warnings.

misconceptions.ask: How long are white cotton handkerchiefs boiled to disinfect them?
misconceptions.repair: Explain heat needs time to kill germs.
Smell a towel dried in a damp corner.
